ai_call_logs_nonneg.name: ai_call_logs_nonneg
ai_call_logs_nonneg.value: "ai_call_logs"."request_chars" >= 0 and ("ai_call_logs"."response_chars" is null or "ai_call_logs"."response_chars" >= 0) and ("ai_call_logs"."latency_ms" is null or "ai_call_logs"."latency_ms" >= 0)

locations_reason_len.name: locations_reason_len
locations_reason_len.value: "locations"."reason" is null or length("locations"."reason") between 1 and 60

personal_events_lock_consistent.name: personal_events_lock_consistent
personal_events_lock_consistent.value: ("personal_events"."lock_location_id" is null) = ("personal_events"."lock_until_minutes" is null) and ("personal_events"."lock_location_id" is null) = ("personal_events"."lock_reason" is null)

player_states_neili_consistent.name: player_states_neili_consistent
player_states_neili_consistent.value: ("player_states"."neili_current" is null and "player_states"."neili_max" is null) or ("player_states"."neili_current" is not null and "player_states"."neili_max" is not null and "player_states"."neili_current" >= 0 and "player_states"."neili_max" >= 1 and "player_states"."neili_current" <= "player_states"."neili_max")
